## States

| State | Rule |
| --- | --- |
| `hover` | background shifts to bg-hover, 100ms ease-out |
| `pressed` | background shifts to bg-selected, no transition |
| `focus` | 2px accent ring, 2px offset, always visible |
| `disabled` | opacity 45%, pointer events off |
| `selected` | bg-selected plus 500 font weight |
